description: This file defines a custom exception class named NotImplementedException within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the API V2 exception namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides a default error message for unimplemented functionality.

classes.name: NotImplementedException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate that a particular feature or method is not yet implemented. It defaults to a standardized message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a default message indicating 'Not Implemented'. It allows optional custom message, code, and previous exception.
